notes: visual-qa-log.json (checkedAt 2026-10-26T00:00:00Z) verdict 'issues' with ONE medium finding: at 375px the Juventus – Napoli row (Serie A, Søndag 1. november, 20:45) shows 'a plain blank/empty outlined square where a club crest should be'.

Reproduced the row directly (375px, both themes). ROOT CAUSE is NOT a broken/failed image load: docs/logos/juventus.png exists (present since WP-186, 22.07.2026) and is a valid, intentionally-minimalist modern Juventus mark — a thin black 'JJ' shield on a TRANSPARENT background. In LIGHT mode (the theme scripts/screenshot.js renders by default, i.e. what visual-qa captures) the mark renders correctly and is clearly VISIBLE. In DARK mode (true-black default, #000000) the black-on-transparent mark is nearly invisible against the page — leaving exactly the 'blank/empty outlined square' the finding describes. So the defect is real but theme-dependent (dark-mode contrast of a monochrome-dark mark), not a broken asset. Nearby crests that render fine (Genoa, AC Milan, Bologna, Bayern) all carry colour, so they survive on true-black.

NO fix is available within ui-fix's frontend-only remit. Every CSS treatment that would make a dark-on-transparent mark visible — background plate, tint, filter/invert, mask, border/radius clip, drop-shadow — is EXPLICITLY FORBIDDEN by the binding mark-integrity contract (DESIGN.md § Entitets-avatar trinn 0 + docs/css/entity-logo.css: 'Vises uendret … ingen omfarging, beskjæring, maskering, tint eller bakgrunnsplate'). ui-fix must not deviate from DESIGN.md without an explicit owner instruction.

A web-only client change (e.g. suppress a dark mark in dark mode and fall back to the theme-safe colour monogram) is also wrong here: the entity-avatar ladder is twinned web<->iOS and must render the SAME verdict on both surfaces (DESIGN.md: 'samme dom på begge flater'), and deciding WHICH marks ship / are theme-safe is a per-asset policy that lives in the pipeline — scripts/config/logo-policy.json + scripts/build-entities.js — which is outside ui-fix's allowed paths (docs/** only; NEVER scripts/**).

Per ui-fix guidance ('Ignore anything that's really a data/pipeline problem — that's the other agents'; 'When in doubt, abandon'; 'A missing fix beats a regression on the live site'), discarded with no code change and no PR, leaving the DESIGN.md mark-integrity contract intact.

RECURRENCE: a prior ui-fix run (2026-10-26) already abandoned this same finding for the same reason; this run independently reproduced and confirmed it. Since the frontend cannot fix it, the finding will keep re-appearing until the pipeline layer acts. Recommended remedy for the pipeline/logo-policy + iOS-parity owners (self-repair/improve or the owner): gate out monochrome marks whose luminance makes them disappear on true-black (so the row falls back to the theme-safe colour monogram on BOTH surfaces), or ship a theme-safe mark variant — i.e. a change in scripts/config/logo-policy.json + scripts/build-entities.js, not in docs/**.
Verified no open PR with head starting 'ui-autofix' before acting (gh pr list → none).
